headline: Microsoft + Atom Computing delivering Magne: 50 logical qubits, first error-corrected quantum computer deployment
details: Partnership delivering Magne to Export and Investment Fund of Denmark + Novo Nordisk Foundation. 50 logical qubits from ~1200 physical neutral atom qubits. Microsoft error correction software + Atom Computing neutral atom hardware. Operational target: start of 2027. Microsoft also launching 2026 Quantum Pioneers Program (QuPP) with up to $1M grants. Majorana 1 chip: topological qubits (8 on chip, designed to scale to 1M).
relevance_reason: 50 logical qubits = sufficient for a small but meaningful fault-tolerant MERA. Timeline (start 2027) aligns with our research trajectory. Microsoft QuPP grants are a funding mechanism.
access_path: Microsoft Quantum Pioneers Program 2026 (research grants up to $1M). Atom Computing cloud access. Monitor Magne deployment timeline.
